name: aeg-d-strong-lensing
title: Galaxy-scale strong lenses: projected mass inside the Einstein radius against projected stars and gas in the same cylinder
description: Atlas conversion of published galaxy-scale strong lenses whose lens is an early-type galaxy (A6) into one projected g_obs and g_bar per system at the Einstein radius (D-064): g_obs = G M_E / R_E^2 and g_bar = G (M* + M_gas)(<R_E) / R_E^2, both labelled projected and never merged with 3D values. Who is plotted and which record is the default follow the frozen precedence rule (docs/methods/A6S_PRECEDENCE.md, D-065), the epoch cut z_l < 0.30 (D-066) and the rulings D-063, D-075 and D-076. Every input was read twice at source and adjudicated (reading/). Stellar masses inside R_E as printed, as luminosity x population M/L, or as a printed total x the source's own light-profile fraction; Chabrier/Kroupa default with a Salpeter top (slider a6s_stellar_imf). Gas inside R_E from the registered term of D-076 item 1 (slider a6s_gas_in_RE). See REPRODUCTION.md, SECOND_READING.md and RESULT_SUMMARY.md.
x_licence_status: Original papers and journal tables: values transcribed with citation, not redistributed (all rights reserved at the journal or arXiv non-exclusive licence, per the packaging inventory; R9 and R33 are CC BY on arXiv). VizieR and AAS machine-readable tables: linked and hash-verified, not redistributed. Atlas tables intended CC BY 4.0 under D-004, citing the sources.
